careerai.comment: Local careerai-mcp server. Install: `cargo install --git https://github.com/justdoGIT/career-ai careerai-mcp` (or grab a prebuilt binary from the GitHub Releases page once tagged). The plugin's slash commands and skills route most calls through this server.

linkedin-jobs.comment: Optional LinkedIn discovery via RapidAPI's LinkedIn Data API (ToS-clean, no scraping; free tier exists). Disabled by default because the upstream repo (Rom7699/linkedin-jobs-mcp-server, verified 2026-04-27) ships as `python main.py` with no [project.scripts] entry, so the uvx invocation above will fail until upstream is packaged or the user pins a packaged fork. To enable: clone the repo locally, run `python main.py` with RAPIDAPI_KEY set, and replace this entry with a command/args pair pointing at the local script. Tracking: PR #19 (mcp_jobs adapter) is the proper long-term path.

linkedin-browser.comment: Opt-in: browser-based LinkedIn scraper. Violates LinkedIn User Agreement section 8.2 (no automated access). Disabled by default. Installed from the upstream Git repo via uvx (not on PyPI; pyproject pins `name = mcp-linkedin` with a matching [project.scripts] entry, so the uvx form works). Flip `disabled` to false at your own risk; rate caps and cookie-jar rotation in careerai-submit still apply.
